findings.msg: at the end of the page the fixed bar covers "back to top ↑": the page cannot scroll further, so it stays under the bar
findings.fix: on a phone nothing lies on anything else: let the section grow with its content (min-height for its screens, never a fixed height; --hm: 2 when it needs two) or cut what it holds; keep pictures and cards off the buttons; pad the page under a fixed bar by the bar's height (top: the first section; end: the footer)
